observations: Black slim-profile game console wrapped in clear plastic film.
One blue wireless controller with a PlayStation logo on the central button.
Watermark 'KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES POSTED ON JIJI' on all images.
All three photos show the same top-down view; no ports, labels, or screens are visible.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to a display.

No photo of the console's user interface showing installed games.
The plastic wrap obscures the actual surface condition and hides potential scratches.

risks.proof: Photo of the sticker on the back of the controller.

risks.risk: The internal storage may be the minimum 500GB or have bad sectors.
risks.proof: Photo of the Storage settings screen.

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the software version.
Photo of the Storage settings showing hard drive capacity.
Video of the console booting up and navigating the menu.

response.reason: The item is identified as a PS4 Slim by its form factor. It is priced at its worst case (non-functional and unhacked) because there is no proof of operation or software version provided in the photos.
